# taptap-maker-builder
A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) skill plugin that takes a game design brief and builds it into a playable,
publishable project on **TapTap Maker** (UrhoX engine + Lua): pick a creation mode, extract the five
elements, write the first prompt, iterate in the official order, accept in preview / on device, the
n check release materials — while keeping credit and credential red lines.
Chinese documentation: README.zh-CN.md. The skill itself is written in Chinese because the product a
nd its docs are Chinese.
## Install
Once listed in the plugin market: **Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market**, search `taptap-maker-build
er`. Before that, install from GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart dsh afterwards. The skill then joins the skill catalog and loads automatically when a matchi
ng request arrives; you can also invoke it by name.
Installing the plugin does not install the environment: it ships no Maker MCP and does not sign you
in to TapTap. To work in a local directory, follow the official docs (`npx -y @taptap/maker init`) a
nd wire the MCP into your IDE.
## When it triggers
- Questions about TapTap Maker / Maker / UrhoX / credits / UI themes / the benchmark leaderboard / l

ocal MCP setup;
- A game design brief attached or pasted with a request to build it, write prompts f
or it, or prepare a release.
Not for: Unity / Unreal and other engines; pure art outsourcing; general programming unrelated to Ma
for: Unity / Unreal and other engines; pure art outsourcing; general programming unrelated to Maker.
